name: Airtable
tagline: Flexible database-spreadsheet hybrid for teams and individuals
painPoints: Team plan is a paid per-seat plan — expensive as teams grow
No proactive AI assistant; Airtable AI is an add-on at extra cost
Building useful bases requires significant time investment
No email or calendar integration for automatic data capture
Automation features are trigger-based, not AI-reasoning-based
metaDescription: Looking for an Airtable alternative? GAIA is source-available AI that triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across 50+ tools. Free tier included.
whyPeopleLook: Airtable's database-spreadsheet hybrid is uniquely flexible — relational fields, gallery views, Gantt charts, and automations all in one tool. But that flexibility comes at a price: a paid per-seat Team plan, plus a paid AI add-on. Building and maintaining Airtable bases is a project in itself, and the platform has no proactive intelligence. It does not read your email, does not know about scheduling conflicts, and does not surface what you should work on today. Users who want their productivity tool to be proactive rather than a database they maintain find Airtable insufficient.
gaiaReplaces: Task tracking without building and maintaining database bases
Workflow automation with AI reasoning instead of rigid trigger-action rules
Email-to-task creation without manual Airtable form submission
Project status tracking via natural language instead of database views
gaiaAdvantages: Zero base-building required: GAIA works immediately with existing tools
Proactive task and workflow management without per-seat pricing
Email and calendar integrated directly, not via third-party automations
Source-available and self-hostable with no data stored in third-party databases
Conversational interface replaces manual grid and gallery view navigation
migrationSteps: Import task and project data into GAIA's task manager or connected Todoist
Connect Gmail to auto-create tasks from email without Airtable forms
Replace Airtable automations with GAIA workflows described in natural language

faqs.question: Can GAIA replace Airtable for database management?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not provide a relational database builder like Airtable. For structured data with custom fields and relational links, Airtable remains more powerful. GAIA is the better choice for proactive personal AI assistance and task automation.

faqs.question: Is GAIA cheaper than Airtable?
faqs.answer: Airtable's Team plan is a paid per-seat plan. GAIA Pro is ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month for one individual with email management, task automation, and 50+ integrations. For teams, GAIA's individual pricing may still be more cost-effective per person. Self-hosted GAIA is free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs).

faqs.question: Does GAIA have Airtable's gallery and Gantt views?
faqs.answer: GAIA does not provide visual database views like gallery, Kanban, or Gantt. Its strength is conversational task management and proactive intelligence rather than visual data presentation.

faqs.question: Can GAIA and Airtable work together?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can connect to Airtable via MCP integrations, reading and writing records as part of automated workflows. Many users keep Airtable for structured data and use GAIA as the proactive AI layer that manages their personal tasks and email.

comparisonRows.gaia: Productivity OS that manages tasks, email, and calendar in plain conversation, with zero base-building before you get value
comparisonRows.competitor: Flexible spreadsheet-database hybrid for building custom project trackers, content calendars, and operational databases with multiple view types

comparisonRows.gaia: Tasks appear on their own from emails, meeting notes, and chat, so you never build a tracker to hold them
comparisonRows.competitor: Manual record creation within Airtable tables; bulk import via CSV; automations can create records from form submissions or integrations

comparisonRows.gaia: Reads and triages your Gmail inbox directly, drafts replies, and turns emails into tasks with no automations to maintain
comparisonRows.competitor: Email parsing available via integrations and automations; no inbox reading, triage, or proactive email management

comparisonRows.gaia: AI that acts across your tools instead of inside one interface: it reasons over email, calendar, and tasks, then does the work
comparisonRows.competitor: Airtable AI for generating text in records, summarising content, and filling fields based on prompts within the Airtable interface

comparisonRows.gaia: Describe the workflow in words and GAIA runs it across tools, replacing rigid trigger-action rules with AI reasoning
comparisonRows.competitor: Rule-based automations for record updates, notifications, and external triggers; integrations with Zapier and Make for advanced cross-tool automation

comparisonRows.gaia: Manages Google Calendar natively: creates events, finds slots, and briefs you before meetings
comparisonRows.competitor: Calendar view of date fields within Airtable; no external calendar management or meeting preparation

comparisonRows.gaia: Watches email, calendar, and tasks in the background and surfaces what needs attention before you ask
comparisonRows.competitor: Automated record updates and notifications triggered by conditions within Airtable; no autonomous monitoring of external context

comparisonRows.gaia: Graph-based memory links people, projects, and tasks automatically, with no relationships to configure by hand
comparisonRows.competitor: Relational database with linked records and formulas within Airtable; relationships are manually configured and maintained

comparisonRows.gaia: 50+ integrations via MCP including Gmail, Slack, Notion, and GitHub, connected conversationally instead of through an app marketplace
comparisonRows.competitor: 100+ native integrations plus the Airtable API for custom connectors; App marketplace with pre-built extensions

comparisonRows.gaia: Source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) and self-hostable via Docker, so your data never sits in a third-party database
comparisonRows.competitor: Proprietary closed-source SaaS platform; no self-hosting option

comparisonRows.gaia: Web, desktop, mobile, and messaging bots, so the assistant meets you where you already work
comparisonRows.competitor: Web application with iOS and Android mobile apps

comparisonRows.gaia: Free tier available; Pro from ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month flat with no per-seat scaling; self-hosting free for non-commercial use (plus your own model API costs)
comparisonRows.competitor: Free plan and paid plans available; per-seat pricing; enterprise tiers available.
